verdict.rationale: Only indirect color-theming evidence exists: generic claims of extensive configurability, 24-bit color support, and the Smart Cursor Color and Minimum Contrast color controls, plus a community mention of a user's Python API script that switches themes with the system appearance, which implies switchable themes exist. Automatic light/dark switching appears only as that user-written script, a workaround that earns no credit. missing for 10: first-party documentation of color schemes/presets and how to apply or import them, built-in automatic light/dark mode switching, independent hands-on corroboration of theming.
